BMC Faces Opposition Over Bandra Reclamation Ground Conversion

The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) is facing opposition regarding its decision to convert a football ground at Bandra Reclamation. Activists have voiced their disapproval of the move, which aims to transform the ground into an exhibition or convention center. Aaditya Thackeray has also claimed that the BMC has already converted the ground. The controversy highlights concerns over the use of public spaces in Mumbai.
